title: Transfer money to an existing UK beneficiary
user_story: As an authenticated customer, I want to transfer money to an existing UK beneficiary so that I can make a secure payment.
acceptance_criteria:
AC-001 | The customer must be authenticated.
AC-002 | The customer must select an existing UK beneficiary.
AC-003 | The transfer must be rejected when sufficient funds are unavailable.
business_context: The transfer journey must provide a secure and traceable customer experience.
known_risks:
Incorrect beneficiary selection
Insufficient-funds validation failure
Duplicate payment submission
